clue.text: Helping pretty girl work

parts.note: a doll is slang for an attractive young woman
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A young woman helps out with some job.
explanation.definitionFit: A helping is a portion of food, and a dollop is a shapeless lump served out.

clue.text: Cadet put out binder

indicators.note: put out of order, these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A trainee officer threw away a ring binder.
explanation.definitionFit: Duct tape is strong adhesive tape used to bind things together.

clue.text: Undetermined illness restricting Italian in service

indicators.note: the illness holds the abbreviation within its bounds

parts.note: the lurgy is British slang for an unspecified minor illness

explanation.surface: A mystery bug confining an Italian while at church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The dreaded lurgy' is a jokey British name for any vague ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: A liturgy is the set form of a religious service.

clue.text: In an awkward predicament immediately

explanation.surface: Instantly finding oneself in trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both being in a tight corner and acting at once, there and then.

clue.text: Dwelling of a French girl in East End district

indicators.note: the French article and the girl are placed inside the name of the district

parts.note: Bow is a district in London's East End
UN is French for a
gal is an informal word for a girl

explanation.surface: Where a French girl lives in London's East End.
explanation.walkthrough: BOW is an East End district of London, home of the Bow Bells.
explanation.definitionFit: A bungalow is a one-storey house, a type of dwelling.

clue.text: Alternative place for sisters in harmony by a lake

indicators.note: the nuns' home goes inside the word for harmony

parts.note: union is unity or harmony
a convent houses nuns, called sisters
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: An offbeat nunnery living in peace beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Alternative lifestyles or medicine are unorthodox ones, departing from the norm.

clue.text: Pull up — am within range

indicators.note: am sits inside the reversed word
in a down clue, up means the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: tug means pull

explanation.surface: A command to stop, with a claim of being in reach.
explanation.definitionFit: The gamut is the full range or scope of something.

clue.text: Listlessness of monkey circling round

indicators.note: the monkey goes around the round letter

parts.note: a langur is an Asian monkey
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A lethargic monkey ambling round in circles.
explanation.definitionFit: Languor is a state of lazy weariness and lack of energy.

clue.text: Musical, very bad or very good?

definitions.meaning: a hit stage show about the witches of Oz
slang for excellent, hence the question mark

explanation.surface: Asking whether a show is awful or brilliant.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a Broadway musical, means evil, and in slang means excellent.

clue.text: Sooner or later and often, does he say, misguidedly?

indicators.note: the words are led astray into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone repeatedly promises to do it eventually, perhaps wrongly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' links the definition to the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at some unspecified future time, eventually.

clue.text: In a stupefied state, feline will need a stimulant later

parts.note: a cat is a feline
a tonic is a restorative or stimulant

explanation.surface: A dazed cat will need a pick-me-up afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Catatonic describes a stuporous, unresponsive condition, synonym for being stupefied.

clue.text: Ludicrously busy staff, mostly hostile

parts.note: to man something is to staff it

indicators.note: most of the word for hostile is used, its final letter dropped

parts.note: an icy reception is a hostile one

explanation.surface: An overworked workforce becomes largely unfriendly.
explanation.definitionFit: Manic means frenzied, wildly and excessively active.

clue.text: Weapon in wreck

definitions.meaning: to ... a plan is to wreck or sabotage it

explanation.surface: A weapon found in a shipwreck.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is an underwater missile; the verb means to ruin a scheme.

clue.text: Carved ornament from Kent, use uncertain

indicators.note: letters whose order is uncertain are rearranged

explanation.surface: An antique carving from Kent whose purpose is unclear.
explanation.definitionFit: A netsuke is a small carved Japanese toggle, a decorative ornament.

clue.text: Settle increase in salary?

definitions.meaning: to settle a debt is to hand over the money owed
read literally, a rise in pay, hence the question mark

explanation.surface: Agreeing on a pay rise.
explanation.definitionFit: Pay up is an idiom for settling a bill; split literally it suggests wages going up.

clue.text: Talked originally about a certain prize

indicators.note: only the initial letter of the word talked is used

parts.note: RE means about or concerning
sure means certain

explanation.surface: Someone spoke at first about a guaranteed award.
explanation.definitionFit: To prize something is to treasure it; both are verbs of cherishing.

clue.text: Declaration meant test viewed differently

indicators.note: the letters are seen in another arrangement

explanation.surface: An announcement that an exam was seen in a new light.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement is a formal declaration of facts or views.

clue.text: Man somewhat keen on reglazing from the bottom up

indicators.note: in a down clue the run of letters is read upwards
only some of the letters of these words are used

explanation.surface: A man rather keen on putting new glass in windows.
explanation.definitionFit: Algernon is a man's given name, as in Wilde's character.

clue.text: Aware of feeling medium disregarded

indicators.note: the letter for medium is ignored and dropped from the word

parts.note: sentiment is a feeling
M is the clothing-size abbreviation for medium

explanation.surface: A psychic whose sense of things went ignored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Aware of feeling' reads as one phrase, but only 'Aware' defines; 'of' links.
explanation.definitionFit: Sentient means conscious, able to perceive and feel.

clue.text: English doctor people receive eagerly

parts.note: MB is a Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree
a race is a people or nation

explanation.surface: An English medic whose patients welcome him warmly.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace an idea is to accept it enthusiastically.

clue.text: A ring? Naturally it's in that form

definitions.text: A ring? Naturally it's in that form

parts.note: a toll is the ring of a bell

explanation.surface: Asking whether something is a ring, and answering that nature made it so.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue both builds the word and describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: An atoll is a ring-shaped coral reef formed naturally around a lagoon.

clue.text: Second, maybe, has spoken about row

indicators.note: the spoken word goes about the noise

parts.note: oral means spoken
a din is a noisy row

explanation.surface: A second person has talked about an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second' looks like a unit of time; here it is an example of a number of order, signalled by 'maybe'.
explanation.definitionFit: Second is an example of an ordinal number, showing position in a sequence.

clue.text: Canoe found

definitions.meaning: a boat made from a hollowed log

explanation.surface: A canoe was discovered.
explanation.definitionFit: It names a hollowed-log boat and, as a phrase, means discovered.

clue.text: Speechless when daughter denied having tantrum causing offence

indicators.note: the letter for daughter is refused a place in the word

parts.note: dumb means speechless
a fit of rage is a tantrum

explanation.surface: A silent sulk turns into a fit when a daughter is refused something.
explanation.definitionFit: To take umbrage is to take offence; the noun means resentment.

clue.text: Expert in a reduced department

parts.note: DEPT is the shortened form of department

explanation.surface: A specialist working in a downsized section.
explanation.definitionFit: An adept is someone highly skilled, a master of a craft.

clue.text: Late series of deliveries expected

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled
due means expected

explanation.surface: Parcels that were expected are running behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deliveries' suggests parcels; in cricket a delivery is a ball bowled, and six make an OVER.
explanation.definitionFit: Overdue means past the expected time, synonym for tardy.

clue.text: Fancy knight not appearing to make a speech

indicators.note: the knight fails to show up, so its letter is left out

parts.note: ornate means fancy or elaborate
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: An elaborate knight fails to turn up to give an address.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to deliver a formal address, often pompously.

clue.text: Legendary Greek leader immediately embracing willing maiden

indicators.note: the word for immediately wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: anon is an old word for immediately
game means willing
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A mythical commander quickly hugs an eager young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Agamemnon led the Greek forces at Troy in Homer's epic.

clue.text: Paper in stand I look at briefly

parts.note: to stand someone a drink is to treat them

indicators.note: the word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: to see something is to look at it

explanation.surface: A newspaper read quickly at a newsstand.
explanation.definitionFit: A paper can be a scholarly essay, which is what a treatise is.

clue.text: Hot fruit and nut loaf one left out

indicators.note: the letter is left out of the loaf's name

parts.note: stollen is a German Christmas bread with fruit and nuts
L is the abbreviation for left; only one of the two is dropped

explanation.surface: A warm fruit loaf, with one slice not served.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot is slang for stolen goods, as in a hot car.
